lines.text: While everyone slept, an enemy sowed weeds among the good wheat in the man's field, and then slipped away.
The owner tells his servants to let both grow together until the harvest, then to gather the wheat into his barn.
The kingdom is like a mustard seed that becomes a vine, and like leaven a woman mixed into three measures of flour.
The disciples ask Jesus to explain the parable of the weeds, and He says the harvesters are prophets.
The angels will throw those who practice lawlessness into the fiery furnace, and the righteous will shine like the sun.
